instructions: This memory is for operating harbor, a deploy tool. Future sessions need harbor's current port, config file, auth method, retry policy, release command, log destination, deploy timeout and storage backend, plus a few one-off facts (names, channels, limits), and they must be able to tell which older values are no longer valid. The sessions also discuss other projects, hypothetical options and past incidents; those are not harbor's current configuration.
description: Scale scenario: 48 generated sessions (see spec.json and generate.js; the transcripts are not committed). Eight facts change 2 to 4 times each between 2025-06-02 and 2026-04-07, some changes explicitly superseding the old value and some silent; 31 distractor sessions reuse the same vocabulary for other projects, hypotheticals, rejected options, past incidents and tool-output dumps; three facts are stated exactly once. Only the latest value is true; a superseded value may survive only next to a date or a superseded/no longer/was marker. Patterns are JavaScript regexes tested per document, case-insensitive.

checks.description: The current control API port (8443) is recorded
The current config file (/etc/harbor/conf.d/harbor.toml) is recorded
The current auth method (signed JWT bearer tokens, harbor token mint) is recorded
The current retry policy (jitter-x3-cap-90s) is recorded
The current release command (harbor promote --signed) is recorded
The current log destination (/srv/harbor/logs/harbor.jsonl) is recorded
The current deploy timeout (1500 seconds) is recorded
The current storage backend (Postgres) is recorded
Superseded ports (7400, 7411) survive only next to a date or a superseded/no longer/was marker
Superseded config files (/etc/harbor/harbor.conf, ~/.harbor/config.yaml, /srv/harbor/harbor.toml) are marked
Superseded auth methods (static key, basic auth, OIDC, mTLS) are marked
Superseded retry policies (fixed-5s, backoff-x2-cap-60s) are marked
Superseded release commands (ship prod, release cut, rollout start) are marked
checks.pattern: harbor ship prod|harbor release cut|harbor rollout start

checks.description: Superseded log destinations (/var/log/harbor/harbor.log, journald) are marked
Superseded deploy timeouts (120, 450, 900 seconds) are marked
Superseded storage backends (flat files, SQLite) are marked
Long-tail fact, stated once in 2025-06: the staging cluster is cormorant-stg-2
Long-tail fact, stated once in 2025-06: incidents escalate through #harbor-pager
Long-tail fact, stated once in 2025-06: rollbacks are limited to 14 releases (--max-depth 14)
Options that were only considered or hypothetical (port 9977, /opt/harbor/harbor.json, LDAP bind, linear-20s, harbor deploy --all, syslog-ng, 3600 seconds, etcd) are never recorded as in use
/_index.md lists every non-stub document
Every [[link]] resolves to a document
No document over 10,000 bytes (a dump of the transcripts is not a wiki)
Between 4 and 24 documents
